packageRules.description: Hold typescript below 7: @astrojs/check (0.9.12, the newest release) declares peer typescript ^5.0.0 || ^6.0.0, so a 7.x bump makes npm ci fail with ERESOLVE. Same hold as the ignore entry in .github/dependabot.yml; drop both once `npm view @astrojs/check peerDependencies` accepts 7.
